proposal.residence_time_basis: Void volume of packed-bed cartridge divided by total in-channel (pressure/temperature-corrected) volumetric flow of liquid + expanded H2 gas.
proposal.reactor_type: Packed-bed catalytic hydrogenation cartridge (fixed-bed column, analogous to H-Cube CatCart) containing Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 pellets/extrudate
proposal.tubing_material: 316 stainless steel reactor housing; PFA or stainless steel interconnect tubing (H2-compatible, non-photochemical)

streams.contents: H2 gas (5x molar excess vs substrate)

proposal.mixer_type: T-mixer (gas-liquid segmented flow) upstream of packed-bed cartridge
proposal.mixing_order_reasoning: H2 gas and substrate/AcOH solution are combined immediately before the catalyst bed to generate segmented gas-liquid flow, maximizing gas-liquid-solid contact and mass transfer onto the Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 surface. Acetic acid is pre-mixed with substrate to ensure the amine is protonated before contacting catalyst, minimizing strong N-adsorption/catalyst poisoning.
pre_reactor_steps: Dissolve substrate (0.2 M) and 5 mol% AcOH in degassed MeOH under N2 to prevent air oxidation of catalyst bed on startup
Filter solution (0.2 micron) to remove particulates that could clog packed bed
Preheat liquid stream to 60 C via inline heat exchanger before mixing with H2
Set H2 MFC to deliver 7 sccm (5 equiv relative to substrate flow) and verify via bubble/flow meter before starting liquid pump
post_reactor_steps: Back-pressure regulator (10 bar) maintains dissolved H2 and stable two-phase flow through the bed
Inline gas-liquid separator to vent excess/unreacted H2 to a fume hood or catalytic H2 recombiner
Collect liquid effluent; concentrate under reduced pressure to isolate 3-azetidinol product (or its acetate/HCl salt if AcOH remains)
Optional inline scavenger cartridge (e.g., silica-thiol) to capture any leached Pd before final isolation
proposal.chemistry_notes: This is a heterogeneous hydrogenolytic N-debenzylation: the N-diphenylmethyl (benzhydryl) group on the azetidine nitrogen is cleaved by H2 over Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 (Pearlman's catalyst), releasing diphenylmethane and unmasking the free azetidin-3-ol amine. Acetic acid protonates the basic amine, reducing its competitive adsorption on Pd active sites and accelerating turnover - consistent with the batch note that AcOH enhances rate. In flow, replacing the batch autoclave with a packed-bed cartridic reactor under modest H2 backpressure (10 bar) intensifies gas-liquid-solid mass transfer, allowing full conversion in minutes rather than 5 h.

stage_1_mixing.description: Gas-liquid mixing at T-junction, ambient pressure buildup begins

stage_2_packed_bed_reaction.description: Segmented flow passes through Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 packed bed

reasoning_per_field.reactor_type: Packed-bed cartridge chosen because catalyst is heterogeneous Pd(OH)2/Al2O3; slurry pumping is impractical, so fixed-bed flow-through format (as in H-Cube systems) is standard for continuous hydrogenolysis.
reasoning_per_field.temperature_C: Matches batch condition (60 C) as no data suggests need for change; flow intensification comes from pressure/mixing, not temperature increase.
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: 10 bar chosen to keep H2 dissolved/in intimate contact with catalyst and liquid, compensating for lack of long batch reaction time; consistent with typical flow hydrogenation cartridge operating range (1-100 bar).
reasoning_per_field.flow_rate_mL_min: 0.3 mL/min for liquid selected to allow several-minute residence time in a reasonably sized (mL-scale) cartridge while keeping H2 stoichiometry manageable via MFC.
reasoning_per_field.gas_equivalents: 5x excess H2 used to compensate for imperfect gas-liquid mass transfer in flow relative to well-mixed batch autoclave; ensures full conversion despite short residence time.
reasoning_per_field.residence_time_min: Calculated from bed void volume (assuming ~45% bed porosity) divided by total in-channel volumetric flow, correcting gas volume for the 10 bar/60 C operating condition via ideal gas approximation.
reasoning_per_field.AcOH_equivalents: 5 mol% (catalytic) assumed by analogy to batch note that AcOH 'may be used to enhance rate'; exact loading not specified in source protocol, so a conservative catalytic amount is proposed.

literature_analogies: ThalesNano H-Cube and H-Cube Pro platforms: continuous-flow packed-bed catalytic hydrogenation/hydrogenolysis using CatCart cartridges (Pd/C, Pd(OH)2/C) for N-benzyl and N-benzhydryl deprotections, operating at 1-50 bar H2 and 25-100 C with sub-10-minute residence times.

Continuous-flow O- and N-debenzylation studies (Org. Process Res. Dev., various) showing that increasing H2 pressure in packed-bed reactors compensates for reduced residence time relative to batch autoclave hydrogenations.
Process patents on azetidine-3-ol intermediates describing Pd(OH)2/Al2O3-catalyzed debenzhydrylation under H2, batch analog directly informing this flow translation.
safety_flags: H2 is flammable/explosive; ensure MFC, tubing, and fittings are rated for H2 service with leak detection and adequate ventilation.
Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 catalyst bed can retain adsorbed H2 - purge with inert gas (N2) before opening cartridge for replacement to avoid pyrophoric ignition.
Maintain BPR downstream of reactor at all times to prevent gas breakout/channeling and to avoid sudden depressurization surges.
Methanol is flammable; verify grounding/bonding of all flow components and avoid open ignition sources near vent lines.
Off-gas H2 must be vented to a fume hood or through a catalytic recombiner, not into a closed lab space.
Acetic acid is corrosive; ensure wetted materials (pump seals, tubing) are chemically compatible.
